## LEARNING - Adapt Difficulty (RFC-022)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/learning-adapt-difficulty

**Parameters:**
- `learner_discord_id` (required): Discord user ID
- `guild_id` (required): Discord guild ID

**Algorithm:**
- avg_score >= 90 & success_rate >= 85 → hard (3)
- avg_score >= 75 & success_rate >= 70 → medium (2)  
- avg_score >= 60 & success_rate >= 50 → easy (1)
- else → easy with reinforcement

**Returns:**
- `recommended_difficulty`: easy | medium | hard
- `difficulty_score`: 1-3
- `metrics`: Learner performance data
- `focus_areas`: Strengths and weaknesses
- `recommendations`: Personalized suggestions
